summary: Add Record Relation: links a target record onto a named relation field of an owner record in the cloud database.
description: Add Record Relation writes a relation — a typed link between database records — rather than a property value: when `store` fires, the record identified by `targetId` is added to the configured relation field of the record identified by `modelId`. `relationAdded` confirms; `failure`/`error` report rejection (missing ids, access control). The reverse operation is Remove Record Relation with identical wiring.
whenToUse: Many-to-many and one-to-many links the schema models as relations: project members, favourites, tags. For plain foreign-key style references stored as a string property, Update Record on an id property is simpler.

ports.modelId: Id of the owner record (the one whose relation field gains a link).
ports.targetId: Id of the record being linked.
ports.store: Signal; performs the write against the cloud database.
ports.relationAdded: Signal; the server confirmed the link.

runtimeBehavior: The class and relation-name choices come from the project's database schema (declared-port-groups + runtime-discovered): the editor generates the pickers and any per-class ports from the schema, so the port set depends on the configured backend, not the node type.
patterns: Ids arrive over wires (component inputs, query outputs); the relation nodes only act on them.
